items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: He's got that Cliff that plays clarinet.

ctx.x:
Yeah. Her name was Hillary. And Old Man Martel wanted me to quit drinking and quit the shoe shop job, and just concentrate on music and stay home. I said, "I ain't gonna do no such thing. I'll work in the shoe shop as long as I want." I needed that extra money. At that time I think we was workin' only two nights a week, because work was falling off for some reason. Anyway, we separated. I wasn't playing with him.
